title: Three small display leftovers: accept 4.5 px of table width, make the header logo link 44 px, alias a Demo viewer's sample name?
bluf: Narrowed after reading the tickets: your earlier cards ruled the Demo page-frame alias, headings and PDF (11 Oct, b) and kept sample names on Service offers (29 Oct, a); PRs 244, 272 and 278 have since built most of the table-width and 44 px work. Three leftovers remain, each unruled. (1) HPSMPOC-401: 8 cells (Customers and Workspace at 1024 px) sit 4.5 px right of the reference, inside the scroll region; accept or fix. (2) HPSMPOC-417: the header logo link is 28 to 40 px high, the only measured link left under 44 px; make it 44 or decline. (3) HPSMPOC-410: a Demo viewer sees 'Quollridge Logistics (sample)' on Home Upcoming activity and the customer profile; use the alias as the security pages do, or keep it as a sample. Default if you do not tap: option A, Tuesday queues it for the build lanes, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-401, HPSMPOC-417, HPSMPOC-410

options.label: Accept the 4.5 px; 44 px logo link; use the alias

default_action: Option A: queue for the web lane; nothing deployed.
